cover_sub: Explore the sector's financial stability and reserves data.

slides.label: Overview
slides.headline: Nonprofit Financial Reserves
slides.body: Approximately 40% of nonprofits show fewer than 3 months of operating reserves. This highlights the need for financial stability across the sector.
slides.accent_label: Nonprofits with less than 3 months of reserves

slides.label: Sector Trends
slides.headline: Reserve Funding Crisis
slides.body: 48% of nonprofits lack adequate emergency reserves, reflecting a critical need for more funding to ensure financial stability.

slides.label: Small Organizations
slides.headline: Small Orgs and Reserves
slides.body: Small organizations under $500K are more likely to have lean reserves, often due to direct investments in programs rather than financial struggles.

slides.label: Data Source
slides.headline: Reliable Data from IRS
slides.body: The data is sourced from public IRS 990 filings, providing a transparent and comprehensive view of the nonprofit sector’s financial health.

slides.label: Implications
slides.headline: Financial Stability Matters
slides.body: For nonprofit leaders and funders, understanding financial stability is crucial for long-term sustainability and the ability to respond to emergencies.

slides.label: Call to Action
slides.headline: Support Nonprofit Stability
slides.body: Invest in nonprofits' financial reserves to ensure they can continue their vital work.

cta_body:
Secure their future.
Support their financial health.
